newsitem.title: USA: InterTrust names business development executive.
newsitem.headline: InterTrust names business development executive.

text.p: InterTrust Technologies Corp said it has named Gail Bronson to the position of vice president of business development and corporate development to blaze new strategic partnerships.

InterTrust supplies software in the middleware category -- between the operating system and applications -- which enables secure electronic commerce and the management of digital rights across computer networks, including the Internet.

Bronson will be charged with evaluating and negotiating partnering arrangements as the startup company seeks to establish its technology as a standard by developing a community of partners, InterTrust said in a statement.
The company said it has already announced major partnering accords with Mitsubishi Corp and Softbank's 9984.Q Softbank

Prior to joining InterTrust, Bronson headed a consulting practice and has served in editorial and business development roles at Bloomberg Business News, Forbes, U.S. News and World Report, Interactive Age and The Wall Street Journal.
